title: Dominic and the Machine Again
author: Cyrus Joubert
blurb: Hazel Ishikawa, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
